knownGaps.summary: UI is effectively English-only for Indic users: app_en.arb has 262 keys but all 10 Indic ARBs carry only 21 (241 keys render English fallback).
knownGaps.why: Contradicts the product's core promise (11 Indic languages first-class, never Hindi-only) and DESIGN_RUBRIC 12.15. Language picker and AI output language DO work across 11; the UI chrome does not.
knownGaps.note: Pre-existing across all shipped screens, not introduced by any one unit. Machine translation of teacher-facing copy needs native review for dignity + pedagogical terminology before shipping.

knownGaps.summary: Brand saffron #FF9933 fails WCAG AA contrast: #FF9933 text on white = 2.13:1, white on #FF9933 (button fill) = 2.13:1 (AA needs 4.5, AA-large 3.0). The original token #E0924D was 2.50:1 and also failed.
knownGaps.why: Founder chose vivid #FF9933 over #E0924D for brand identity. Contrast is a real accessibility issue (rural low-end screens, sunlight). NOT auto-fixable without either darkening the saffron for text/CTA use (e.g. a #C2410C-ish 'saffron-700' for on-white text while keeping #FF9933 for large brand surfaces) or using dark text on saffron buttons.
options: use a darker saffron shade ONLY for text/CTA-on-white while keeping #FF9933 for brand surfaces/large fills
dark onPrimary text on saffron buttons
knownGaps.note: Left untouched pending the founder's call. Saffron is currently used as text/icon at dashboard tiles, quiz correct-answer mark, plan badge.
knownGaps.resolution: Founder-approved accessible split (2026-07): LIGHT primary/ring = #C2410C deep saffron (5.18:1 on white -> saffron text AND white-on-saffron CTA both pass AA); DARK primary stays vivid #FFAB57 (9.7:1 on near-black) but dOnPrimary fixed white->#231200 (white on bright saffron was ~1.9:1, a pre-existing dark-button bug the contrast test caught). brandSaffron #FF9933 reserved for large brand moments only. Locked by test/core/theme/theme_contrast_test.dart.
